variants.headline: Party leader faces a public scandal
variants.body: A scandal concerning a party leader has come to light in {colony}. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.

variants.headline: Leadership under an unwelcome spotlight

variants.headline: A scandal tests political trust
variants.body: A scandal about a party leader has become public in the colony. We judge the stewardship of {target} inadequate; practical responsibility should be assessed against a demanding standard.
